title: Bounded local klt complements for Fano contractions
exact_target: For every $d>0$ and positive rational $\varepsilon $, does an integer $N(d,\varepsilon )>0$ work for each normal integral $\varepsilon -lc$ Q-Gorenstein d-fold over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field with a projective connected-fiber contraction $f:X\to Z$ and relatively ample $-K_X$, so that near each closed base point there is effective rational B with (X,B) klt and $N(K_X+B)$ integral Cartier and linearly trivial?
